decision: Use an explicit immutable staged source reader throughout every producer and configuration/body input seam. Admission predicates alone cannot establish staged-byte provenance.

interface.readFile: (absolutePath: string) => string; immutable UTF-8 text from the admitted snapshot; missing, malformed UTF-8 or unadmitted input throws
interface.listDirectory: (absolutePath: string) => readonly { name: string; kind: 'file' | 'directory' }[]; names only, no dot, slash or symlink entries

producer_option: sourceReader?: InventorySourceReader on every affected typed inventory/config/body API; omitted preserves existing ordinary behavior
constraints: No global filesystem replacement, fake clean checkout, hidden default body or fallback to live reads when a reader is supplied.

The production reader is created only from trusted-host admitted exact stage0 blob bytes and a private same-run dependent-body overlay; a serialized caller object is never production admission or mutation authority.
Enumerate snapshot-only files even when absent on disk; exclude live-only files. Walk ignore, extension and declaration behavior remains the same.

Configuration, declared surfaces, registry, use-cases, SQL and dependent bodies use the same reader. Missing or malformed required inputs block the diagnostic operation rather than producing an incomplete PASS.
All seven native body producers receive exact current-run inputs. The ordinary clean-candidate guard and final native readiness behavior remain unchanged.
This checkpoint authorizes independent pure-reader RED only. It does not claim complete B1 runtime authority, Owner approval intake, index adapter, schemas or effects are implemented.
source_path_closure: inventory.proposed.json plus the 18 exact missing_candidate_paths in inspector-review.json; no unrelated sensor algorithm or threshold change
required_counterexamples: Each producer reads staged A when the live path holds B.
Staged-only files are discoverable; live-only files never enter the result.
Staged configuration and dependent bodies override poisoned live defaults without consulting them.
Reader errors remain blocking, including invalid/missing inputs; no catch-and-skip or live fallback.
Ordinary no-reader outputs and failure behavior remain unchanged.
